title: When can the next task start?
caption: A connected Petri net makes a lifting resource and the installed roof explicit. Tokens determine which selected work events can start.
look: Follow the release event into the shared resource place, then inspect the roof event.
limit: A finite, once-only construction; this is not a complete engineering or scheduling model.
state: Default example: A blocked method becomes possible; nothing completed.
alt: A connected Petri net makes a lifting resource and the installed roof explicit. Tokens determine which selected work events can start.

title: Can all five local rules agree?
caption: Five specialist exclusion rules overlap on a triangular site. Filled dots satisfy them all at the same sampled location.
look: Compare Balanced with No global fit, then select a dot to inspect its five margins.
limit: A finite sampling toy. Zero passing samples does not prove that every point between samples is impossible.
alt: Five specialist exclusion rules overlap on a triangular site. Filled dots satisfy them all at the same sampled location.

title: Find the feedback group
caption: Reordering the same six activities brings their mutually dependent group into one block of the matrix.
look: Compare the collected and partitioned orders. A row receives information from a column.
limit: The matrix records information dependencies, not durations, resource capacity or iteration counts.
state: Reorder activities tab; One feedback group.
alt: Reordering the same six activities brings their mutually dependent group into one block of the matrix.

title: Keep three kinds of thing distinct
caption: Objectives, stakeholders and scope occupy separate layers while links connect them across a rail-project example.
look: Read the layer names, then follow the guide’s new track → carbon ambition → town council chain.
limit: Nodes are unlabelled in this overview. The source does not define weights as probabilities or causal influence.
alt: Objectives, stakeholders and scope occupy separate layers while links connect them across a rail-project example.

title: See a complete crossing choice
caption: The selected implementation becomes two crossing sites, guide fencing and observation points in an invented landscape.
look: Change the brief or select another compatible choice, and compare the displayed resources.
limit: The picture is not to scale; capacities and costs are declared assumptions, not predictions of animal use.
state: Default 110 model-crossings/day brief; 30 m + 50 m bundle.
alt: The selected implementation becomes two crossing sites, guide fencing and observation points in an invented landscape.

title: Put the project inside its context
caption: A context comb keeps project processes and surrounding activity in one picture, with an explicit exchange between them.
look: Follow the wires left to right through setup, project/context actions, exchange and assessment.
limit: One generic interaction round. This diagram does not by itself implement an optic or feedback controller.
alt: A context comb keeps project processes and surrounding activity in one picture, with an explicit exchange between them.

title: What does one more buffer day buy?
caption: The blue curve shows the model’s risk index as Development receives buffer; the bars show the next day’s marginal reduction.
look: Compare the steep first reduction with the diminishing reductions later on.
limit: An uncalibrated teaching formula. The percentages are not a measured probability of project failure.
state: Reset scenario; Development selected; zero buffer.
alt: The blue curve shows the model’s risk index as Development receives buffer; the bars show the next day’s marginal reduction.

title: Join two modules at one handover
caption: Barge-service planning and depot-receiving planning expose the same draft-offer interface at their boundaries.
look: Change Separate modules to Joined graph: the two B vertices become one.
limit: Boundary identity is declared. Matching the graph does not establish staffing, agreement or compatible histories.
state: Separate modules; coordination summary off; matching interface.
alt: Barge-service planning and depot-receiving planning expose the same draft-offer interface at their boundaries.

title: Compose two mobilisation processes
caption: Two mobilisation boxes each produce a team and a blueprint. A swap brings like outputs to their separate merge boxes.
look: The crossing changes wire order; the boxes below it perform the proposed merges.
limit: Symbolic typed composition does not establish that actual teams or blueprints can be combined.
alt: Two mobilisation boxes each produce a team and a blueprint. A swap brings like outputs to their separate merge boxes.

title: Look at one project through fourteen views
caption: A microsite project is grouped into task, schedule, cost, resource and other views. Connections distinguish relations from proposed mappings.
look: Hide a view or select a red connection marker to read what a link means.
limit: A relationship sketch. The coloured regions are not verified categories, and functor laws are not checked.
state: Separated layout; all views and connections visible.
alt: A microsite project is grouped into task, schedule, cost, resource and other views. Connections distinguish relations from proposed mappings.

title: Make competition for the lane visible
caption: This shared-lane Petri-net fragment makes two competing starts and the return of one reusable access token visible.
look: Trace each start, occupancy and finish, including the token’s return to Lane free.
limit: This is a map of possible transitions, not a timed schedule or a probability model.
alt: This shared-lane Petri-net fragment makes two competing starts and the return of one reusable access token visible.

title: Reconcile four directors’ views
caption: Strategy, Product, Portfolio and Operations describe the same imagined company through different kinds of objects.
look: Follow outcomes, outputs, features and services across the four grouped views.
limit: The cross-view relationships are proposed assumptions for the example, not a universal business schema.
alt: Strategy, Product, Portfolio and Operations describe the same imagined company through different kinds of objects.

title: Keep plans attached to their assumptions
caption: Regional plans are grouped by their shared context. A comparison points back towards the baseline with fewer constraints.
look: Turn on the Asian privacy observation, then read the projection arrows and the direction of the context comparison.
limit: A fibration candidate and supplied-rule explorer; no cartesian lifting property or real acceptance is established.
state: Asian privacy change on; other constraints off; shared contract authorised in the toy.
alt: Regional plans are grouped by their shared context. A comparison points back towards the baseline with fewer constraints.

title: Separate doing from becoming true
caption: A waste-removal job is drawn as tasks, the conditions those tasks achieve, and the roles allocated to them.
look: Compare Prepare Waste extraction plan with Plan agreed; one is work, the other its assumed result.
limit: Allocation edges do not check resource availability; preparing a plan is assumed to achieve agreement.
alt: A waste-removal job is drawn as tasks, the conditions those tasks achieve, and the roles allocated to them.

title: Collapse a feedback loop into one group
caption: The condensed graph treats the mutually connected Load model, Frame design and Foundation design as one component.
look: Compare this chain with the matrix tile: it keeps inter-group order while hiding internal detail.
limit: Grouping does not remove iteration or supply a feasible project schedule.
state: Reorder activities tab; One feedback group.
alt: The condensed graph treats the mutually connected Load model, Frame design and Foundation design as one component.

title: See what abstraction forgets
caption: Two detailed preparation routes map to a single abstract route while their input and output boundaries remain.
look: Notice that route identity disappears even though endpoints and boundary types survive.
limit: This is a graph map, not evidence that the routes take equal time or can substitute in practice.
alt: Two detailed preparation routes map to a single abstract route while their input and output boundaries remain.

title: The plan before the cows
caption: The original whiteboard connects moving and pouring concrete with wagon, workers and shuttering inside a chosen scope.
look: Notice the access assumption left outside this project-only picture; compare the companion cow sketch.
limit: No cattle in this branch does not mean no risk. The original handwriting and image quality are retained.
alt: The original whiteboard connects moving and pouring concrete with wagon, workers and shuttering inside a chosen scope.

title: Let an outside process into the plan
caption: Cattle-to-market and weather enter the original sketch. The road is shared, and the concrete move is crossed out.
look: Read the crossed-out move as temporarily disabled while access is occupied, then compare the explicit lane net.
limit: The sketch motivates the corrected model; it is not itself a fully specified executable process.
alt: Cattle-to-market and weather enter the original sketch. The road is shared, and the concrete move is crossed out.

title: Read joint work as a composed arrow
caption: With two independently supplied lifts, the frame and roof task arrows can appear alongside one another in one admitted step.
look: Choose Show two independent lifts, then Lift frame + Lift roof in Inspect a possible step.
limit: Tensor notation alone does not guarantee joint starts: the input-token check is retained separately.
state: Two independent lifts; joint step inspected, not executed.
alt: With two independently supplied lifts, the frame and roof task arrows can appear alongside one another in one admitted step.

title: Narrow the view and notice what disappears
caption: The carbon objective and its two immediate outgoing objective neighbours form a small, readable neighbourhood.
look: Compare this close-up with the three-layer overview: no scope or stakeholder links remain here.
limit: This is objective-only, not a whole-network neighbourhood. Some original labels are clipped; the guide names them.
alt: The carbon objective and its two immediate outgoing objective neighbours form a small, readable neighbourhood.

title: Connect strategy to delivery and operations
caption: A programme schema connects strategic objectives, programme outcomes, programmes, projects, work packages, services and consumers.
look: Follow the links crossing between the strategic, delivery and operational parts of the drawing.
limit: An earlier toy schema, drawing on public university material and guessed details; not an adopted organisational model.
alt: Strategy, Projects and Operations are grouped around Programme Outcomes, with links between strategic objectives, delivery work, services and consumers.

title: See which branch has room to move
caption: A seven-task dependency network shows the critical branch and the float on documentation and training.
look: Select Show network; compare a buffer day on Development with one on Documentation.
limit: The declared network is small and fixed. Timing is separate from the illustrative risk-response formula.
state: Reset scenario; Show network; no buffers.
alt: A seven-task dependency network shows the critical branch and the float on documentation and training.

title: Inspect an early task-to-token translation
caption: The first two waste-removal tasks become transitions, with states and roles represented as places carrying token properties.
look: Read the guide’s qualifications about initial tokens, zero consumption and roles that are not returned.
limit: An incomplete source fragment with unresolved token meanings and no firing engine.
alt: The first two waste-removal tasks become transitions, with states and roles represented as places carrying token properties.

title: Connect software tools with possible data
caption: Software libraries and platforms are linked to particular datasets proposed for exploration.
look: Follow a tool-to-dataset link and consider what question that pairing might help investigate.
limit: Historical possibilities, not a validated method-selection rule or current performance claim.
alt: Two columns headed Code Libraries and Data connect tools such as Python spaCy, Keras and Orange to named datasets.

title: Read just the task chain
caption: Identify waste, prepare the extraction plan, commission suppliers and remove waste appear as a simple task sequence.
look: Compare with the combined task/state/resource view to see what the simpler chain leaves implicit.
limit: A stored order of actions; no schedule calculation or resource check.
alt: Identify waste, prepare the extraction plan, commission suppliers and remove waste appear as a simple task sequence.

title: Choose the practices a portfolio needs
caption: The framework groups portfolio work into governance, reporting and control, and programme/project delivery support.
look: Use the three branches to orient the practices being discussed in the framework guide.
limit: An earlier organising framework, not a complete retained toolkit or proof of organisational effectiveness.
alt: The framework groups portfolio work into governance, reporting and control, and programme/project delivery support.
